name: Lombard Street Crooked Block — Hyde to Leavenworth
scope: Accepted Lombard public realm/access context; 1040 Lombard architecture reset to source-truth acquisition with no accepted building geometry.

coordinate_system.working_crs: NAD83(2011) / San Francisco CS13 meters (EPSG:7131) preferred for city geometry

anchor.definition: Hyde/Lombard anchor from recovered Lombard source truth (OSM node 65360287 / EPSG:3717), cross-checked against DataSF street centerline; preserve for rough review revisions until an explicit frame correction is approved.

microblocks.use_policy: Aggressive only where sub-block fidelity materially improves curves, slopes, curb transitions, stairs, wall caps, planter edges, railings, and façade detail; vanilla blocks remain default bulk mass.
microblocks.validation: exact Astra block-entity and microcell readback required

source_policy.licensed_raw_imagery: private/ignored; commit URLs, IDs, metadata, measurements, and derived geometry only

review_gate.purpose: Review 1040 Lombard's conservative source shell for footprint registration, site relationship, and absolute scale only.
notes: Judge footprint placement against the accepted driveway and Lombard context.
Judge overall envelope height against the street and neighboring buildings.
Do not judge facade appearance; the shell is intentionally neutral and hollow.
No roof form, storey lines, openings, bays, terrace, pergola, foundation or facade styling is asserted.
Public realm and neighboring buildings must remain unchanged.

rejected_review_artifacts.reason: Full stair systems were generated before the reconstruction had physically expanded out to support them; floating/outboard stairs violated the road-outward workflow.
The blue 1040 facade interpretation was not source-measured and must not be reused as building truth.
Minecraft flyaround showed a flat decorated sheet: oversized planar windows, excessive timber lines, fence-like top structure and no reliable source-measured depth.
Although 3D, the massing still assigned bay, entry, terrace and pergola dimensions before a registered multi-view/source-measurement gate. User requested complete removal and a data-first restart.

superseded_review_artifacts.reason: Temporary outer review cutoff was incorrectly rendered as generic vertical terrace-edge geometry.
